issues.test_name: [It] [bc-serial] PTP e2e tests PTP ClockSync Slave can sync to master [Serial]
issues.ai_summary:
---

**TL;DR:** Transient T-GM GNSS instability on cnfdf32 caused 17 of 18 failures; 1 is a deterministic WPC NIC lab misconfiguration.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_other
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (18 failures across 7 suites)

### 15/18 failures — Slave ptp4l lock timeout after daemon restart
- **Suites:** bc, dualfollower, dualnicbc, dualnicbcha, oc | **Evidence:** PROVEN (uniform ~200–260 s timeout; `interfaces receiving PTP frames: []` across all 5 suites)
- **What:** After `RestartPTPDaemon()`, slaves never logged "selected best master clock" within the 3-min `Eventually` (`ptptesthelper.go:71`); no upstream PTP frames seen at suite start in any affected suite.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** yes
- **Fix:** Retry the job; if recurs, audit GNSS/ts2phc lock on cnfdf32 before daemon-restart steps.

### 3/18 failures — T-GM not in LOCKED state at TGM suite start
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN (T-GM recovered mid-run: bc-serial ClockClass-6 test passed at 04:08 same job)
- **What:** All 3 TGM tests timeout at `checkClockClassState(ClockClass6, 5min)` precondition (`ptp.go:2659, 2706, 2818`); cnfdf32 had transient GNSS loss when the TGM suite executed.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** yes
- **Fix:** Retry; add a pre-suite T-GM stability gate that waits for ClockClass 6 before launching TGM tests.

### 1/18 failure — TBC topology: no WPC NIC solution found
- **Suites:** tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN (`graphsolver.go:73`: "Solution for TBCWithSlavesExtGM does not exist"; deterministic across retries)
- **What:** `PtpConfigTelcoBC()` `BeforeEach` finds zero ports satisfying the ≥3 co-PHC WPC NIC constraint (`testconfig.go:1899`); all downstream tbc tests skip as `discoveryFailure`.
- **Breaking change:** Candidate (unverified): [ptp-operator#205](https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator/pull/205) introduced the tbc suite on `main` without WPC hardware validation.
- **Flake?** no — deterministic lab configuration mismatch
- **Fix:** Add a WPC NIC capability-check skip guard in tbc `BeforeEach`, or provision WPC-capable lab nodes.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | Slave can sync to master | bc | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | ptp4l never locked after daemon restart | Retry |
| 2 | Downstream slave can sync to BC master | bc | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | ptp4l never locked after daemon restart | Retry |
| 3 | Can provide a profile with higher priority | bc | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | ptp4l never locked after daemon restart | Retry |
| 4–6 | (same 3 tests) | dualfollower | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | MetricClockStateLocked never achieved | Retry |
